tables.description: One row per day stem (the day master): the site's one-line reading of it and the classical passages on that stem.
One row per day stem and month branch: the site's reading of being born in that month (in or out of season) and the classical passages on climate balance (tiao hou) for that pair.
One row per day pillar and hour branch, with the classical passages on a day stem born at that hour.
One row per stem-branch pillar with its na yin element and the classical passages on that pillar's na yin.
One row per Ten God with the classical passages on it.
One row per chart pattern taken from the month command (as met on real charts), with the classical passages on the pattern and on choosing luck pillars for it.
One row per symbolic star (shen sha): how the site looks it up, how other books differ, and the classical passages on it.
One row per topic heading of the BaZi classics that the reading engine looks up (temperament, family, wealth, luck...), with its passages. topic_en is a working label, not a reviewed translation.
